primary.title: Bank holiday next week: SBI, HDFC, others closed for four days between June 22 and June 28; check here
primary.summary: Private and public sector banks in India will be closed for four days next week from 25 to 28 June 2026 due to regional holidays, including Muharrum and weekends. Customers should check the RBI holiday calendar for specific bank closures across different states.
